children: Sanofi's deal to expand its alliance with U.S. peer Regeneron Pharmaceutical provides a boost to the French company's early-stage drug pipeline, J.P. Morgan analysts write in a research note. The conclusion of the negotiations with Regeneron is positive for Sanofi, the analysts say. Sanofi will pay Regeneron $1 billion upfront, and up to $7 billion subject to certain targets to get access to four new drug candidates invented by its partner. Now that an agreement with Regeneron has been reached, Sanofi investors are likely to switch their focus to the company's moves to strengthen its business through dealmaking, the analysts say. Sanofi shares rise 2%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
